character.appendages: Only two short attached ears/top points may protrude. They bend and compress with the body. No limbs, independent tail, floating snow pieces, halo or detached ornament may be added.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas is 64x64 with source origin [24,42]. All 83 Main/Sub slots use that common origin. Compact forms contact near the origin, tall forms extend upward, diagonal forms retain their local displacement and flat forms extend laterally. Canonical aliases and source translations remain authoritative.
character.faceAndExpression: The face changes with the body: a compact neutral mask becomes a large dark vertical mouth or muzzle opening in tall alarm/stretch poses, shifts toward the leading side in diagonal poses, compresses near the ground and disappears in rear, silhouette, stone or fully flattened states.
character.locomotion: The whole body compresses low, rocks side to side, stretches vertically, leans diagonally, lifts slightly and collapses into a long flat state. Preserve raw sequence IDs and timing; do not assign or invent action names.
character.morphology: Tiny ground-contact snow-soft body with one continuous rounded mass and two short top points. The original replacement may read as a compact canine face and ears, but may not gain legs, paws, arms, wings or a separate tail.
character.restraint: Main cells 027-043 form the restrained block, including aliases. Gold-brown binding wraps the central body as the creature remains compact, leans, stretches upright or collapses flat. The band is an external prop and must not become fur, anatomy or a platform.
character.specialStates: Main 044/046 are orange-red special-color states; 047 is the black tall silhouette; 048 is the black compact silhouette; 061 is stone-gray; 062 is a distinct very flat pale-blue state; 064 is the white evolution silhouette. Derive palette/silhouette states deterministically only where alpha equivalence proves the contour.
